verdict.rationale: Insomnia's own Collection Runner sends multiple requests in a specified order, and docs advertise automatically testing multiple requests in a collection with unlimited runs. That is a first-party way to act on many items at once, and Inso CLI can automate those runs in CI. However, nothing documents general bulk actions such as multi-select edit, delete, move or update of requests or environments. Missing for 10: documented bulk edit/delete/move across many items, a bulk-operation API or CLI commands beyond test/lint runs, and hands-on corroboration.
